title: Typed Knowledge over Constructive Institutions: A Proof-Relevant Type Theory for Verified Science
abstract: arXiv:2611.15108v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mathematical proof assistants such as Coq, Agda, and Lean 4 build proof irrelevance into definitional conversion ($p \equiv q$ for $p, q : P$ with $P : Prop$), erasing which derivation established a theorem. While natural for mathematics over fixed axioms, judgmental proof irrelevance is incompatible with verified scientific stores, which must inspect and compare independent derivations of the same claim to assess consilience and compute counterfactual retractions when an assay, reagent, or model is invalidated. Moreover, combining definitional proof irrelevance with subsingleton elimination breaks strong normalization and renders algorithmic conversion non-transitive.   We present the type-theoretic and institutional foundations of Eigenius, a verified knowledge substrate for science. translated_title: 构造性机构之上的类型化知识：一种面向可验证科学的证明相关类型论
translated_abstract: 诸如 Coq、Agda 和 Lean 4 之类的数学证明助手在定义等价中内置了证明无关性（即对于 P : Prop 且 p, q : P，有 p ≡ q），从而抹去了定理究竟是由哪条推导所建立的。虽然这对于基于固定公理的数学而言是自然的，但判断式证明无关性与可验证的科学知识库不相容：后者必须检查并比较同一命题的多个独立推导以评估其契合度，并在某个实验、试剂或模型失效时计算反事实的撤回。此外，将定义式证明无关性与子单例消去相结合会破坏强规范化，并使算法化的等价判定失去传递性。我们提出了 Eigenius 的类型论与机构论基础，Eigenius 是一个面向科学的可验证知识基底。首先，我们构造了一个具有累积宇宙的依赖类型内核，包含非直谓的 Prop、以及带有索引强制的子单……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了面向可验证科学知识基底 Eigenius 的证明相关依赖类型论，通过摒弃判断式证明无关性，使系统能够追踪并比较同一命题的多个独立推导、保持强规范化与传递性的等价判定，并支持在实验或模型失效时计算反事实撤回。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the proof-relevant dependent type theory underlying Eigenius, a verified knowledge substrate for science, which abandons judgmental proof irrelevance so that independent derivations of the same claim can be tracked and compared while preserving strong normalization and transitive conversion, and supports counterfactual retractions when experiments or models are invalidated.
